name: Uplift + Backreaction Certificate - Tier 2

uplift.mechanism: Positive supersymmetry-breaking V_up(z) = ε U(z) with ε << λ_min(M) (Theorem 4.6)
uplift.backreaction: O(ε) shifts to fermion masses and moduli, controlled by the Hessian at z*

computation_method: Implicit function theorem on the uplifted potential V_phys = V_susy + V_up. Robust against specific uplift mechanism.
closure_action: Replaces any remaining uplift-related CANDIDATE or EXTERNAL. The period-derived predictions are uplift-independent at leading order.
honesty_note: The geometric predictions (masses, mixings, Λ) are robust; only the vacuum energy and SUSY-breaking scale depend on the uplift details.
